_comment: Work order, not evidence. Derived from the acquisition manifest.
`title`, `authors`, `year`, `type` are SEARCH HINTS used to find the primary document.
`manifest_claims` is QUARANTINED: it is read only by the manifest-vs-source discrepancy
checker and must never be copied into a corpus record. Every published field comes from
the retrieved primary document. `candidates` are unverified identifiers; each one is
resolved live before use and a non-resolving identifier becomes a finding, not a record.
